{{Quote|For over a thousand generations, the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic. Before the dark times. Before the Empire.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
The '''Imperial Era'''—also known as the '''Age of the Empire''' or '''post-Republic era''', and sometimes regarded as the '''Dark Times''' or the '''reign of the Empire'''—was the [[time]] period that covered the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], lasting from [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[New Order]] in [[19 BBY]] until the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]] in [[5 ABY]]. The Imperial Era followed the [[Republic Era]] which lasted for a [[millennium]], and preceded the short-lived [[New Republic Era]]. Its final [[Standard year|years]] overlapped with the [[Galactic Civil War]], a period known as the '''Galactic Civil War era''', the '''Rebellion era''', or the '''era of Rebellion'''. '''Age of Rebellion''' referred to the time period from [[0 ABY]] to [[4 ABY]]. After the [[battle of Endor]] since the death of Sheev Palpatine and his reign of terror came to an end, the one-year period from 4 ABY to 5 ABY became known as the '''fall of the Empire'''. Following the rise of the [[New Republic]], the Imperial Era was referred to as the '''Old Empire era'''.

The rise of the Empire marked the [[Sith]]'s return to power. [[Emperor]] Palpatine was the public identity of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious whose [[Grand Plan|plan]] involved the [[Order 66|extermination]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. The [[Great Jedi Purge]] continued throughout the Emperor's reign, leaving [[Luke Skywalker]] as the sole surviving [[Jedi Knight]] by the time of the [[Battle of Endor]] in 4 ABY. Sidious' reign ended with his first [[death]] at the hands of Skywalker's [[Parent|father]], the [[Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] who sacrificed himself while protecting his [[Skywalker family|son]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] rebranded itself as the New Republic, and achieved a decisive victory over the Empire at the [[Battle of Jakku]] in 5 ABY.

Despite its defeat, the Empire's reign inspired a generation that was disillusioned by the state of [[the galaxy]] under the New Republic, from the [[Centrists]] who advocated for strong leadership to the militaristic [[First Order]]. The [[warlord]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] viewed the Imperial Era as a period of order and stability that the First Order sought to restore. To others such as [[Senator]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the Empire's history was marked by tyranny, oppression, and [[Destruction of Alderaan|genocide]].

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|For a thousand years we have kept to the shadows, not afraid of the Jedi—but ''ourselves''. The dark side is powerful. It is ''too'' powerful. The weak will meekly stand in regimented order. The Sith… One master. One apprentice. No more. For generations. Generations building to ''me''.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Darth Vader 20">[[Darth Vader (2015) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 20]]</ref>}}
[[File:Galactic_Senate.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic Era was an age of peace that lasted roughly a thousand years.]]
The modern [[Galactic Republic]] was formed in the aftermath of the last [[Jedi-Sith War|conflict]] between the [[Jedi Order]] and the [[Sith]], ending an [[Fall of the Old Republic|age of strife]] in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]]. What followed was a period of peace and relative stability known as the [[Republic Era]], in which the Republic governed [[the galaxy]] for a [[millennium]]<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> under the leadership of the [[Galactic Senate]] and the protection of the [[Jedi Knight]]s.<ref name="Galactic Republic DB">{{Databank|galactic-republic|Galactic Republic}}</ref> Unknown to the [[Jedi]], the Sith were reformed under [[Darth Bane]]'s [[Rule of Two]], ensuring their order's survival in the form of a [[Sith Master]] and a [[Sith apprentice]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> A new lineage of [[Sith Lord]]s originated from Bane,<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> resulting in generations of Sith that culminated in [[Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] who ultimately achieved his order's [[Grand Plan|plan]] of revenge against the Jedi.<ref name="Darth Vader 20" />

While the Sith plotted their eventual return to power,<ref name="Darth Vader 20" /> the Republic reached the pinnacle of its power and prosperity while expanding into the [[Outer Rim Territories]], resulting in a golden age known as the [[High Republic Era]]<ref name="Light of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref> which also saw the Jedi Order's influence spread to the farthest edges of known [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 2">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]]</ref> This period gave way to an age of rampant [[Politics|political]] corruption and [[bureaucrat]]ic stagnation in the Republic Senate<ref name="Galactic Senate DB">{{Databank|galactic-senate|Galactic Senate}}</ref> by the [[time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" />

[[File:V-wing_SWDConv.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic Era's final years were marked by the Clone Wars.]]
By infiltrating Republic [[politics]] as [[Senator]] Sheev Palpatine of [[Naboo]], Sidious secured his [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|election]] to the office of [[Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Episode I" /> As planned, the Palpatine chancellery grew increasingly powerful due to the [[Separatist Crisis]] and the subsequent [[Galaxy|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars]], both of which Sidious masterminded in order to gain more power for himself. The Clone Wars was the first full-scale war since the formation of the Republic roughly a thousand years before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. The Senate's Jedi peacekeepers lacked the manpower to defend the Republic on a galactic scale,<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> and as such became [[Jedi General|leaders]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Episode III" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|In order to ensure the security and continuing stability, the Republic will be reorganized into the first Galactic Empire! For a safe and secure society!|Sheev Palpatine, to the Galactic Senate|audio=Palpatine-Proclamation.flac|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
[[File:Declaration.png|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial Era began when Darth Sidious proclaimed himself Emperor of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY.]]
The reign of the [[Galactic Empire]] was known as the Imperial Era.<ref name="SWTVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The era began with the [[proclamation of the New Order]] in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> and was characterized by the implementation of [[Galactic Emperor]] Sheev Palpatine's political program, referred to as the [[New Order]].<ref name="EotG">''[[Servants of the Empire: Edge of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Although the [[Emperor]] did bring peace to the galaxy as he had promised, that result was achieved through brutal repression.<ref name="OTFL" /> [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] remembered the Jedi Order as guardians of peace and justice in the Galactic Republic; compared to the millennium of the Republic Era, the Imperial Era was a "dark time" from Kenobi's perspective.<ref name="Episode IV" />

During the early [[Standard day|days]] of the Imperial Era, the Emperor's priorities included the shutdown of the [[cloning]] facilities on [[Kamino]],<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> the [[occupation of Raxus]] and other worlds controlled by the former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Common Ground">{{TBB|Common Ground}}</ref> and the fulfillment of the [[Great Jedi Purge]] through [[Order 66]]. The Grand [[Army]] of the Republic was reorganized into the [[Imperial Army]],<ref name="Aftermath" /> and [[clone trooper]]s continued to serve in its ranks. However, continued support for the clone [[trooper]] program was deemed too high despite the [[Kaminoan]]s' defense of their enterprise,<ref name="Replacements">{{TBB|Replacements}}</ref> and the Empire therefore turned to a new [[stormtrooper]] [[Project War-Mantle|program]] which aimed to replace clones with enlisted [[soldier]]s.<ref name="Elite Squad">{{Databank|elite-squad|Elite Squad}}</ref>

[[File:Stormtroopers-move-through-flame.png|thumb|right|250px|The Imperial Military swept throughout the galaxy, while its ranks were slowly but surely replaced by natural born recruits.]]
The Clone Wars ended with the [[Battle of Utapau|demise]] of [[General]] [[Grievous]],<ref name="Aftermath" /> the [[Mission to Mustafar|slaughter]] of the [[Executive Separatist Council]] by the Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on [[Mustafar]], and the subsequent deactivation of the [[Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Episode III" /> The Confederacy of Independent [[Star system|Systems]] consequently collapsed in a vacuum of leadership,<ref name="Aftermath" /> allowing the Empire to seize control of their worlds and resources.<ref name="Common Ground" /> While [[Decommissioning facility|decommissioned]] [[battle droid]]s were destroyed,<ref name="Decommissioned">{{TBB|Decommissioned}}</ref> Separatist citizens found their worlds subjugated by the [[Imperial Military]]. One such [[planet]] was the Separatist [[capital]] of [[Raxus Secundus]], where the Empire sought to pacify the civilian population through the use of [[propaganda]] and the presence of a large contingent of clone troopers supplemented by [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]s.<ref name="Common Ground" />

The systematic termination of the Jedi succeeded in reducing the Order's ranks to a small group of survivors who fled into hiding. The remaining Jedi were hunted by their brethren who turned to the [[dark side of the Force]], such as [[Darth]] Vader and the [[Inquisitorius|Imperial Inquisitors]]. In addition to the fallen Jedi Knights-turned-[[Jedi hunter]]s,<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> the [[Purge Trooper|final generation of clones]] grown from the [[Jango Fett]] [[Clone template|genotype]] were activated and programmed to fulfill the mandate of the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="Dark Lord 16">[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]]</ref>

===War and downfall===
{{Quote|We kept the skeleton of the Republic for nearly twenty years while the Death Star was constructed. Twenty years, my apprentice. All that planning is now a layer of dust orbiting around Yavin… Now, we no longer have the Senate to hold order. We do not have the Death Star to force it. Our greatest weapon is gone. Our production is in ashes. We are besieged. In all these years, we have never skirted closer to disaster.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Darth Vader 1">[[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]]</ref>}}
The Empire's final [[Standard year|years]] were marked by the [[Galactic Civil War]] from approximately [[4 BBY]]<ref name="Mustafar date">The {{Databank|url=mustafar-history-gallery|title=Mustafar History Gallery}} states that the [[action at Mustafar]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 BBY]], was one of the earliest rebel victories in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Therefore, the Galactic Civil War must have begun by 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> until the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]]<ref name="TFA VD" /> in [[5 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> This period within the Imperial Era was known as the "Galactic Civil War era," the "Rebellion era,"<ref name="TLJ ICS">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> or the "era of Rebellion."<ref name="Knights of Fate">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref>

[[File:Poe_Dameron_21_Star_Wars_40th.png|thumb|left|250px|The Galactic Civil War saw the downfall of the Imperial Era as it faced a growing tide of revolution]]
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was officially formed when Senator [[Mon Mothma]] issued the [[Declaration of Rebellion]] after the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in [[2 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> As a result, the reign of the Empire<ref name="A New Dawn">[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]</ref> was also, in due time, the Age of Rebellion<ref name="Launchpad">{{InsiderCite|229|Launchpad}}</ref> in which [[Mon Mothma's rebel cell]], the [[Phoenix Cell]], the [[Spectres]], the [[Massassi Group]],<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> and other Rebel cells united in common cause to overthrow the Empire and restore the galaxy to [[Democracy|democratic]] rule.<ref name="Alliance DB">{{Databank|rebel-alliance|Rebel Alliance}}</ref>

Emperor Palpatine [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|disbanded]] the [[Imperial Senate]]<ref name="Episode IV" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Senate Dissolution Note">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> no longer seeing a necessity in preserving<ref name="Darth Vader 1" /> the "last remnant of the Old Republic"<ref name="Episode IV" /> after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]] became fully operational.<ref name="Darth Vader 1" /> In the same year, the [[Death Star]] was destroyed by the [[Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]], killing a large number of soldiers, [[Imperial officer]]s, and [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> The [[battle station]]'s destruction was seen as a significant loss by the Emperor, who had neither a ceremonial Senate to keep the [[star]] systems in line nor a [[superweapon]] to enforce his rule.<ref name="Darth Vader 1" />

At the same time as the Rebellion's war against the Empire, the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate re-emerged under [[Lady]] [[Qi'ra]],<ref name="Crimson 1">[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]]</ref> who launched a [[War against the Sith|secret war]]<ref name="Hidden Empire 2">[[Hidden Empire 2|''Hidden Empire'' 2]]</ref> to free the galaxy from the control of the Sith.<ref name="Crimson 1" /> She focused her efforts on an ancient artifact known as the [[Fermata Cage]], which she falsely claimed contained an [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Fermata Cage)|ancient Sith Lord]] to draw both Vader and Sidious in and allow her to lock both away.<ref name="Aphra (2020) 29">[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 29|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 29]]</ref> Unwilling to risk that Sith Lord's possible existence<ref name="Hidden Empire 1">[[Hidden Empire 1|''Hidden Empire'' 1]]</ref> and eager to test themselves against such a foe,<ref name="Hidden Empire 4">[[Hidden Empire 4|''Hidden Empire'' 4]]</ref> Sidious and Vader personally led the [[Imperial Military]] to stamp out Crimson Dawn in the [[Battle at Amaxine Station]]. Through the intervention of the [[Knights of Ren]],<ref name="Hidden Empire 5">[[Hidden Empire 5|''Hidden Empire'' 5]]</ref> the Cage was destroyed, sending out a [[Force Wave]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters 32">[[Bounty Hunters 32|''Bounty Hunters'' 32]]</ref> that disrupted the connection between Force-sensitives and the Force for a time.<ref name="Star Wars (2020) 34">[[Star Wars (2020) 34|''Star Wars'' (2020) 34]]</ref> Additionally, a droid revolutionary from the [[High Republic Era]] named [[Ajax Sigma]]<ref name="Revelations 1">[[Revelations (2022) 1|''Revelations'' (2022) 1]]</ref> re-emerged while a [[Scourge crisis|droid corruption]] known as the [[Scourge]] spread across the galaxy.<ref name="Dark Droids">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-marvel|text=SWCE 2023: Marvel Reveals ''Star Wars: Dark Droids'' Horror Event and More}}</ref>

[[File:ImperialCenter-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Emperor's death was celebrated on worlds throughout the galaxy, including the Imperial capital of Coruscant.]]
The [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]], meanwhile, was built to replace the first Death Star. [[Mission to reveal the Death Star II|Alerted to its existence]] by two Crimson Dawn agents, [[Bevelyn]] and [[Jon Melton]],<ref name="Star Wars 28">[[Star Wars (2020) 28|''Star Wars'' (2020) 28]]</ref> the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] attacked and destroyed the battle station during the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Episode VI" /> in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> The battle also caused the [[Imperial Navy]] to lose several [[Star Destroyer]]s, including the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]'', and the Emperor was killed by his Sith apprentice Vader,<ref name="Episode VI" /> whose sacrifice fulfilled the Jedi prophecy of the [[Chosen One]].<ref name="Beware the Power of the Dark Side!">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> From [[Bespin]] and [[Parades on Tatooine|Tatooine]], to [[Rally on Naboo|Naboo]] and [[Coruscant]], people across the galaxy openly [[Uprisings against the Galactic Empire|celebrated]] the Alliance's victory and the Emperor's demise. The [[Ecumenopolis|city-world]] of Coruscant was the site of a [[Riot in Monument Plaza|riot]] in [[Monument Plaza]] where civilians toppled a statue of the late Emperor.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:RavagerFalls-BattleOfJakkuLastStand4.png|thumb|left|250px|The fall of the ''Ravager'', considered the symbolic end of the Imperial Era]]
The combination of the Emperor's death and the Empire's final defeat at the [[Battle of Jakku]] ultimately marked the end of both the Galactic Civil War and the Imperial Era,<ref name="Lost Stars" /> with the crash of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Ravager]]'' into the sands of [[Jakku]] being considered the symbolic end of the Imperial Era and the dawn of the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Last Stand 4">[[Battle of Jakku — Last Stand 4|''Battle of Jakku — Last Stand'' 4]]</ref> The Galactic Senate was restored as the [[New Republic Senate]];<ref name="New Republic DB">{{Databank|the-new-republic|The New Republic}}</ref> the Imperial capital of Coruscant was ceded to the [[New Republic]] and placed under the administration of a [[Coruscant's provisional government|provisional government]];<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> and the Empire was reduced to a [[Inner systems' Imperial remnant|rump state]].<ref name="First Order DB">{{Databank|the-first-order|The First Order}}</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|It is the task of the First Order to remove the disorder from our own existence, so that civilization may be returned to the stability that promotes progress. A stability that existed under the Empire, was reduced to anarchy by the Rebellion, was inherited in turn by the so-called Republic, and will be restored by us. Future historians will look upon this as the time when a strong hand brought the rule of law back to civilization.|Kylo Ren|<ref name="TFA novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Hux_and_Starkiller_Base.png|thumb|right|250px|Influenced by the Imperial Era, the First Order sought to rule the galaxy as the Empire's successor.]]
Although the Empire fell, an [[Unknown Regions Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]] sought to overthrow the New Republic and reorganized into the [[First Order]],<ref name="TFA VD" /> a military-controlled state similar to the Empire.<ref name="Poe 2">[[Poe Dameron 2|''Poe Dameron'' 2]]</ref> It eventually [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroyed]] the New Republic and started a [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[Resistance]], an opposing military force created by [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

The "Old Empire era"<ref name="TFA VD" /> created a legacy that left the galaxy politically divided, with [[Populists]] rejecting the degree of authority and control that characterized the Old Empire, while the [[Centrists]] supported some aspects of the Imperial system which they viewed as necessary to maintaining peace and order. Organa rejected any argument in defense of the Empire that [[Destruction of Alderaan|annihilated]] her [[homeworld]] of [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref> However, her [[Skywalker family|son]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], a former [[Jedi]] who became a First Order [[warlord]], regarded the Imperial Era as an age of stability and the Empire a force for progress.<ref name="TFA novel" /> His rival, [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] was also a strong supporter of the First Order's cause, having developed an admiration for the power of the Empire since [[Youngling|childhood]].<ref name="General Hux DB">{{Databank|general-hux|General Hux}}</ref>
